changed: Recorded the Phase 0-1 review (R-1 to R-8, with evidence and what was not run) and wrote ADR 0026 (plugin layout and a reusable core). The owner accepted ADR 0026 on 2026-10-15 with an amendment: plugins build on a common base of contracts and the SDK, and the SDK gains shared provider helpers. The Phase 1d plan gained Task 1d.7b (SDK HTTP helper, dependency closure) and feature F-1d-7b; the plan and ADR agree on driver_factories, DriverFactory, DriverRequest and the refs fold.
open_items: D1-D6 answered at their defaults by the owner's plan approval (2026-10-15); Part B starts with Task 1d.2

rulings.ruling: The common plugin SDK is contracts plus SDK, not an SDK-only import surface
rulings.cost_if_wrong: if the owner wanted one import surface, the SDK must re-export contract records and the guest contract must forbid e_agent.contracts in a later task

rulings.ruling: The HTTP helper sits in the SDK behind an optional extra, with one named ignore_imports entry for httpx
rulings.cost_if_wrong: a separate distribution would be needed; the helper module moves and the exemption is removed
